name: length_from_the_wire_tag112_3_octets
citation: MISB ST 1201.3 §7.4; ST 0601.14a §8.112 Length row reads 'Variable'
note: The same value at three widths, each with its own constants. A codec that pinned tag 112's Max Length of 8 would decode all three of these wrongly and return a plausible number for each.
